revision: September 29, 2026 · clear cover, Phoenix and no-bend mounting
scope: One grounded 120 V supply, one printer at a time. The design uses a clear-cover BUD NBF-32226 enclosure, proposed reuse of the professor’s aluminum sheet and an internal adapter connection. Six owned equipment groups, including the existing USB cable, are retained. The selected 15 A Q0 and upstream-only voltage-lead protection still require application acceptance. No purchase, physical fit, thermal test or electrical release is claimed. Closed-lid USB export is used only after unplugging mains; the internal portion of the existing USB cable requires rated insulation and accepted assembly.
result: STOCK, USB ASSEMBLY AND ELECTRICAL ACCEPTANCE OPEN

materials.checked: Current published case is 216 × 63 × 47 mm; older guide gives 203 × 69 × 58 mm. Existing unit has the right voltage / CT / USB connector families.
materials.remaining: Measure this unit including plugs and magnetic feet. Verify the restraint, clearances, firmware and ELOG configuration.

materials.checked: The white hinged case, label layout and partially visible “DENT 50…” match the legacy Mini HSC 50 A / 333.3 mV product. This is a probable variant identification: wires obscure the complete model. DENT 20 A and 50 A Mini HSC versions share the body and 10 mm aperture; both accommodate one printer-hot conductor. Set ELOG from the uncovered label at commissioning, not from appearance.
materials.remaining: Uncover the existing label during assembly and enter its actual current/output in ELOG; validate positive watts against a reference load/meter.

materials.model: DENT LD-SKTSP series · 10 in / 254 mm nominal
materials.checked: User confirms three original DENT kit pigtails in different colors, all with the same voltage-sensing function. The connector, tinned end and ESIS card match the LD-SKTSP family. A1 feeds L1 hot; A2/A3 feed L2/N neutral. Colors identify connections; these leads do not carry printer load current or serve as PE.
materials.remaining: OEM kit identity is confirmed. Accept original pigtail termination and protection by the upstream 15 A Q0 before use; original-kit status alone does not establish suitability.

materials.checked: Three leads connect A1/L1, A2/L2 and A3/N. Plug family looks consistent with the photos.
materials.remaining: Measure actual complete and flexible lengths, mating engagement, cable OD and minimum bend radius. The revised 2 m / 3 mm coil scenario is an assumption, not evidence that the supplied leads fit.

materials.checked: Reuse the original CUI 9 V / 0.667 A center-positive adapter, with its P5 plug and flat cord intact. It plugs into the internal XA cord connector; its original cable runs directly to the logger. No DC extension, coupling or wall feedthrough.
materials.remaining: Owned. Verify full plug seating, restraint, cable slack and temperature during the closed-enclosure pilot.

materials.checked: 400 × 300 × 160 mm ABS/PC box with a clear polycarbonate cover. Same manufacturer base and panel pattern; the exact factory STEP is displayed without scaling.
materials.remaining: 103 in DigiKey direct stock at $111.88, checked September 29, 2026. Reconfirm at checkout. Received-part fit, latches, access protection and machining acceptance remain required.

materials.checked: Fabricate the professor’s offered aluminum into a 260 × 340 mm panel with 10 mm corner chamfers. The 1.89738 mm thickness is a provisional template, not measured stock. Verify thickness, stiffness, the 229.8 × 325.3 mm M5 support pattern and the aluminum-compatible PE bond before cutting.
materials.remaining: Reuse proposed, not received or measured. Verify mounting pattern, bonding, screw stacks and stiffness before fabrication.

materials.checked: 15 A, one pole, C curve, UL489 / cUL Listed E320373; 10 kA, 277 V AC. Consolidates the breaker into the existing DigiKey order. Manufacturer STEP defines the wall opening, short DIN rail and bonded aluminum bracket. Review the thermal-magnetic curve against startup and original voltage-lead protection.
materials.remaining: DigiKey direct stock: material price $21.57; 3,689 in stock when checked 2026-09-29. Reconfirm price and stock before ordering. Shipping, tariffs, sales tax and fabrication are excluded from the selection total.

materials.checked: Use a complete cord connector inside the box, matching the printer output connector SKU. A dedicated 14/3 SJOOW branch connects JL/JN/PE to XA upstream of CT. The connector body encloses its terminals and clamps the cord jacket. No wall outlet, custom bracket or wall cutout.
materials.remaining: Catalog UL498 File E13393 / CSA LR-406. Verify the cord clamp and secure both XA and the adapter on the panel; plugs remain fully seated.

materials.checked: One five-port connector each for JL, JN and PE. JL accepts Q0 output, printer hot, A1 and adapter hot; JN accepts supply, printer, A2, A3 and adapter neutrals; PE accepts supply, printer, panel, outlet and Q0-mount earth (all five PE ports used). One accepted conductor per port. Confirm original DENT pigtail preparation and protective-bonding suitability.
materials.remaining: Three mounting positions in the panel drawing. Conductor acceptance is checked at assembly.

materials.checked: Three 221-505 carriers, each with two M3 fasteners.
materials.remaining: Transfer-drill actual fixing holes and verify underside fastener clearance.

materials.checked: Use the same 14/3 SJOOW cord for all three runs. XA’s jacket enters its integral cord clamp; branch conductors terminate at JL/JN/PE before CT. Nominal OD approximately 9.17 mm is inside the 515CV 6.22–16.64 mm clamp range. Final route lengths are dry-fit allowances.
materials.remaining: Selected length allowance; final ends trimmed only after dry routing.

materials.checked: 515PV is grounded NEMA 5-15P, 15 A / 125 V; 14 AWG and the 9.17–9.27 mm jacket fall within its listed acceptance ranges.

materials.checked: 515CV is grounded NEMA 5-15R and matches 515PV cable acceptance. It receives the printer’s original mains plug.

materials.model: Existing USB-A to USB-B data cable · retain full length
materials.checked: Reuse the one existing DENT USB-A to USB-B cable without cutting or splicing it. USB-B stays connected to DENT inside; the same cable passes through the wall and ends in USB-A outside. After printer shutdown, Q0 OFF and unplug SUPPLY IN, connect the free USB-A end to the PC. Disconnect from the PC before restoring mains; the cable stays on the box.
materials.remaining: User confirms the cable is owned. USB 2.0 Figure 6-10 gives an 11.5 × 10.5 mm maximum standard-B overmold (15.57 mm diagonal); Table 6-5 gives nominal cable ODs 4.06–5.21 mm. These are design references, not measurements of this cable. Check passage, condition, usable reach and accepted internal insulation before assembly.

materials.model: Southwire 14 AWG, 19-strand Class C, THHN/THWN/MTW, 600 V

materials.checked: Two #8–10 rings fit the dedicated #10 panel and rail/bracket bond studs. The Phoenix screw-clamp terminals accept bare prepared copper and do not use ring lugs. Aluminum and steel contact methods still need electrical acceptance.

materials.checked: For small wire bundles and the screw-fixed bases. Keep allowed bend radii and avoid crushing insulation. This length is for cables, not a strap around the meter.

materials.model: VELCRO ONE-WRAP 90340 · 19.05 mm (3/4 in) wide roll

materials.remaining: Four straps proposed; actual fit, plug retention and temperature remain physical checks.

materials.model: Alpha Wire F2213/4 BK105 · black FIT-221, 600 V

Retain the selected black 600 V tubing only on the internal portion of the existing cable, across the wall edge and at the DENT termination. The exterior free cable does not require an extra purchased lead. Approve sleeve application and complete coverage on the actual cable.
materials.remaining: Assembly acceptance required: measure connector passage, full coverage and end retention. Approve the recovery process for the cable/connector materials; do not infer heat-application safety from continuous operating ratings.

materials.checked: One intact existing USB cable passes directly through this insulating bushing. Nominal mounting hole 22.2 mm; passage 17.5 mm, head 24.2 mm, height 14.3 mm; accepts walls up to 6.4 mm. The standard USB-B overmold diagonal is 15.57 mm, leaving 1.93 mm nominal diametral passage margin. This is edge protection, not a cable clamp or ingress seal.
materials.remaining: DigiKey lists 6,537 in stock at $0.14 for one on 2026-09-23; recheck at checkout. Dry-fit the intact USB-B plug through the loose bushing before sleeving. Confirm received-bushing fit, insulation coverage and cable retention before drilling.

printers.name: UltiMaker S5
printers.published: 100–240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, maximum 500 W (S5 user manual, PDF p.10).
printers.assessment: 500 W / 120 V = 4.17 A only at unity power factor. This is a power-based screen, not nameplate current or inrush. Check installed peripherals and actual US plug.

printers.name: Bambu Lab P2S
printers.published: Official regional quick-start guide, printed pp.36 and 38: low-voltage version 100–120 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 1000 W at 110 V. Initial bed heating can sustain maximum power for about 3–5 minutes.
printers.assessment: 1000 W / 110 V = 9.09 A only at unity power factor. Verify the actual label next to the inlet, inrush and any AMS/dryer power paths. This design does not support a 200–240 V regional unit.

printers.name: Prusa CORE One+
printers.published: Published CORE One+ specifications report a 240 W PSU and typical PLA/ABS printing consumption of 90/110 W. The current product page has moved to Gen 2; confirm the actual unit.
printers.assessment: A PSU rating and typical print consumption do not establish maximum AC input current. Confirm the user’s generation, AC nameplate, US cord and accessories; no exact maximum-current claim is made.

corrections: Selected direct-stock BUD NBF-32226 with a clear polycarbonate lid. Factory shell, lid and latches are modeled at 1:1 scale.
Proposed reuse of the professor’s aluminum sheet, with stock measurement and aluminum bonding held open.
Moved XA and the original adapter inside. XA uses the same 515CV SKU as the printer output, with a continuous 14/3 cord branch.
Removed the round DC extension, KVT frame and insert from the active BOM and model. Restored XA and DC wall stock; one protected direct-cable opening supports closed-lid export.
Retained six cable anchor points and added separate straps for XA and adapter.
Consolidated purchase sources and added exact-part approval evidence and a conditional DIN-breaker comparison.

Simplified to one confirmed-owned USB cable through a snap bushing. Deleted the panel coupler, short cable and two M3 flange sets. Existing six supports and required internal insulation remain; direct-cable pull retention and plug passage need physical acceptance.

Phoenix 2907571 remains selected. Replaced the folded bracket with a flat bridge and two 65 mm M5 posts; added all purchased post hardware. Updated cordgrips to self-stock Heyco M3231 / 8463, with Ø22.2 mm wall bores. Materials total $262.86 from DigiKey and Home Depot; per-line price dates remain visible.

Re-routed the printer PE curve around the left/rear corner; regression screening of the displayed 1.7 mm-radius wire against the machined shell rejects the former spline overshoot. Physical routing remains an assembly check.

assembly.title: Verify stock and machine empty parts
assembly.action: Measure the offered aluminum and received enclosure. Close thickness, mounting and bonding decisions; use the linked machining files. The right wall has one Ø22.2 mm USB cable exit; no USB flange fixing, XA or DC openings. Dry-fit the bushing and cable, deburr all holes and eight strap slots, and clear chips.
assembly.result: Digital cut and restored-wall checks only; no material has been received or machined.

assembly.title: Fit underside hardware and panel
assembly.action: Fit the six cable mounts and carrier fasteners, thread four equipment straps and check underside projections. Seat the panel on its factory supports. Install four separately purchased M5 × 10 mm panel screws after checking engagement.
assembly.result: Nominal vertical insertion screen; actual stock thickness and fastener stacks need measurement.

assembly.title: Restrain logger, CT and terminals
assembly.action: Fit the logger with two adjustable straps; retain three WAGO groups, one CT and a dedicated aluminum-panel PE connection. Confirm CT label and cable slack.
assembly.result: Catalog envelopes and routed cable geometry only; no physical retention test.

assembly.title: Install Q0, glands and internal power
assembly.action: Fit two 65 mm M5 posts, the flat aluminum bridge, 60 mm DIN rail, two stops and Phoenix Q0. No bending is required. Check the external handle, full travel and accepted bonding of rail, bridge and posts. Fit two Heyco M3231 glands with separate 8463 nuts, then the restrained internal XA/adapter and USB bushing.
assembly.result: Internal layout proposal; actual plug engagement, anti-unplug retention and thermal suitability remain open.

assembly.title: Connect and dress the cables
assembly.action: Connect the XA 14/3 branch before CT. Route the intact original DC cable to the logger. Use the existing USB cable directly through the protected wall opening, with accepted 600 V insulation on its entire internal portion and protected termination. Use the existing front/right support to prevent external pull reaching DENT. Keep mains and low-voltage routes separated and perform offline ELOG setup.
assembly.result: Electrical topology and digital routing checks; not a qualified electrical acceptance.

assembly.title: Close and verify the pilot
assembly.action: Disconnect the exterior USB-A end from the PC, stow it and close the clear lid before mains operation. The complete cable remains attached to the box. Qualified personnel complete electrical and closed-enclosure thermal checks. After the pilot, unplug mains and connect that same USB-A end to export with the lid closed.
assembly.result: No energized test, temperature test or finished-assembly certification recorded.

needed: CT commissioning: Mini HSC family is matched; 50 A is probable. Read the unobscured label during assembly and set that exact range/output in ELOG.

Voltage-lead acceptance: the user confirms the original DENT kit pigtails; do not re-request OEM identity. Accept terminal preparation and upstream-only protection with responsible electrical personnel; original-kit status alone does not establish protection by the 15 A main breaker.
Measure aluminum sheet size, thickness and stiffness; approve aluminum-compatible panel bonding and adjust machining/fasteners before fabrication.

Verify internal XA/adapter seating, independent restraint, intact DC cable slack, separation and closed-enclosure temperature. Clear cover allows visual inspection; verify recording by offline export after the pilot.
Commissioning: verify fastener stacks, CT latch and cable slack, supply conditions, PE/insulation/polarity, total load and restart/recording behavior before routine operation.

USB assembly: verify B-out/A-in orientation, received cable/sleeve dimensions, accepted sleeve application and end coverage, retention, separation and shield treatment. Prove setup/export with mains unplugged and the lid closed; then disconnect its exterior USB-A end from the PC before restoring mains. No isolation or ingress rating is claimed.

Measure Q0/rail engagement, bracket wall fit, operator travel and support stiffness; accept the rail, bridge and both steel-post bonding paths. Recheck the Phoenix C curve against printer startup; Carling pulse-tolerance evidence no longer applies.
